title: Meme Spot the Difference
description: Hunt down hilarious visual gags, anachronisms, and sneaky meme details across comical cartoon scenes before the timer ticks down.
controls: Pan and zoom the illustrated scene, then tap every oddity or hidden meme clue to mark it off the list.

zh-CN.title: 玩梗找不同
zh-CN.description: 爆笑热梗找茬大合集！放大仔细搜遍离谱又熟悉的漫画名场面，揪出藏在角落里的穿帮细节与隐藏笑点。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动或缩放画面观察细节，点击画面中的异常穿帮点或不同之处即可标记收集。
